title: Disability Compensation Monthly Entitlement: Rule of Assessment
content:
**§1 Retired clause.** The clause under which the gross monthly entitlement for an entitlement month was the veteran-alone rate of the combined rating tier in effect for that whole month is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**§2 Amounts added to the monthly entitlement.** To the monthly entitlement are added the SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) award on the award, up to the SMC (k) maximum, and — only where additional amounts for dependents are payable at the tier — the spouse addition when a spouse is recognized, the spouse aid-and-attendance addition when the recognized spouse is marked as needing aid and attendance, the child addition for each recognized child under the child age limit, the school-child addition for each recognized school child, and the parent addition for each recognized dependent parent up to the parent maximum. Every one of these amounts is the figure the product's rate schedules give for the tier.

**§3 Retired clause.** The clause under which a dependent counted for an entitlement month when the month was on or after the first entitlement month paid with its addition and before the first entitlement month paid without it after its removal is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**§4 Individual unemployability.** When individual unemployability is in effect, the individual unemployability rate replaces the veteran-alone rate, and the dependent additions are taken from the 100 percent tier.

**§5 Incarceration.** Where the incarceration adjustment applies to the month, the incarcerated rate replaces the whole computation.

**§6 Precision.** Amounts are kept to the cent and are never rounded to the dollar.

**§7 Award status.** A monthly payment is released only while the award status is running. The status is read from the award record of the award being paid; a monthly payment is not released on an award that is authorized, suspended or terminated.

**§8 Retired clause.** The clause under which a reissue repeated the gross amount of the payment it replaced is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**§9 Net amount.** The amount deposited or mailed for a payment is its gross amount less the amount withheld to collect a VA debt and less the amount withheld for a representative's fee. For a routine monthly payment the fee withholding is always nothing.

**Illustration of §9 (hypothetical figures).** A monthly payment with a gross amount of 1500.00 from which 150.00 is withheld for a VA debt is deposited at 1350.00.

**Illustration of §2 (hypothetical award).** At Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) the award records a spouse and a child; because additional amounts for dependents are not payable at that tier, neither adds anything, while an SMC (k) award on the same award still adds its SMC (k) amount.

superseded_clauses: The gross monthly entitlement for an entitlement month is the veteran-alone rate of the combined rating tier in effect for that whole month
A dependent counts for an entitlement month when the month is on or after the payment_adjust_month of its addition and before the payment_adjust_month of its removal.
A reissue repeats the gross amount of the payment it replaces.
